thread:
elaine: Heads-up — external pen test scheduled Tue 10am by BlackHawk. Scope: API endpoints, private deploy path (VPC), KMS integration, and RBAC changes we pushed last month. Need preflight checklist + retest window plan.
sam: Thanks — I'll own the intake matrix. Quick Q: do we want assessors to have read-only access to S3 logs or a snapshot export?
elaine: Prefer snapshot export to avoid live creds exposure. Keep it timeboxed.
ram: For KMS we should avoid granting raw decrypt rights. Suggest we create a temporary KMS-decrypt-proxy role that calls a restricted service which returns only hashed artifacts.
lina: +1 on proxy. Also we need to ensure audit-stream includes both the proxy's service account and the load balancer IPs. Otherwise logs look incomplete.
sam: I'll add audit-stream checks to the intake board. Action items: snapshot request mechanism, proxy role, RBAC exception list, retest window options.
elaine: Can people add to the fix-queue column in the triage board? We want devs to estimate time-to-fix for each finding in hours.
ram: Doing a quick sketch of ephemeral role policy. Will post sample.
ram: ```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {"Effect":"Allow","Action":["kms:Decrypt"],"Resource":"arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789:key/ephemeral-proxy","Condition":{"StringEquals":{"kms:ViaService":"ec2.us-west-2.amazonaws.com"}}}
  ]
}
```
lina: That looks tight. We also need to log KMS:Decrypt events to our SIEM and tag them with assessor-session-id. Can sec-bot create a rule for that?
sec-bot: @lina rule created: "kms-decrypt-assessor" -> forwards KMS CloudTrail events where principalTag:assessor-session to #security-audit. Retention: 180d.
sam: Great. For evidence handoff, we'll provide presigned S3 snapshot links valid for 48h and scoped to the assessor's fixed IP ranges.
elaine: Retest windows — propose two 2-hour slots the week after fixes: Wed 9–11 and Fri 14–16. If they need more, we can offer a paid extra slot.
ram: On RBAC: last month's changes with the "service-admin" role are the riskiest. We should inventory who has that role and freeze role edits during the engagement.
lina: I can run a quick IAM export: `rbac export --since 2026-01-01 --roles service-admin` and upload to the triage board.
sam: I'll put a blocker flag on any change PR touching auth code until retest completes.
oncall: Reminder — on-call rota will be staffed during retest hours. Please @oncall if you need escalation.
elaine: Thanks team. Next steps: Sam creates intake ticket + triage board, Ram finalizes proxy policy, Lina exports RBAC snapshot, Sec-bot confirms log rule, Everyone estimates fix hours by EOD today.
sam: Will do. Filing intake now: https://boards.internal/triage/42
lina: Uploaded RBAC export and S3 snapshot instructions.
ram: Policy posted in the ticket.
elaine: Closing loop — we'll sync tomorrow 9am for a 15m preflight. :thumbsup:
sam: :thumbsup:
